text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The pack swings out of the fourth corner into the home stretch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (—Right here! From this very moment...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My legs... feel so heavy...! Even though I have to make my move from here...!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Urrrghhh, aaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line! In first place is Satono Diamond!!
Like sunlight after a storm, the diamond shines radiantly!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*... *pant, gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad, Satono Diamond!!
Feels like you've still got plenty of room to grow, I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You looked like you were struggling at the end, but you gave it your all!

Something felt off about her running during the race.
Towards the end, Satono Diamond was clearly exhausted.
"Could it be that... she ran all the way to the racetrack before the race, exhausting her stamina...?"

If I hadn't run, I wouldn't have made it to the race in time.
It couldn't be helped, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...It took everything I had just to finish the 2000m...
And it surely looked that way to everyone watching, too...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (To be honest, that final stretch was agonizing... I couldn't bring out any of my late burst at all...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Such running... is so far from the ideal...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The winner of the Satsuki Sho, where the fastest Umamusume wins,
can't be satisfied with running like that...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (There's no way I could ever call myself a great Umamusume!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you run all the way to the racetrack.
Sorry for making you run all the way to the racetrack, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer, it's not something
you need to apologize for!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I agree that getting out of the taxi
and running was the best choice back then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... why did the weather have to be terrible today of all days?
To not even be able to show 100% of my strength..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Is this also because of the Satono jinx...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However, if this is a jinx—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All I have to do is break through it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: At the next Japan Derby! I'll overcome the jinx, and this time, with a perfect run, I will claim victory!!

Satono Diamond declares with conviction.
Facing bad luck seemed to have fired her up even more,
determined not to let any jinx beat her.
